title: Keycloak: MariaDB Connector/J is used to connect applications developed in Java to MariaDB and MySQL databases…
description: A security vulnerability affects the Keycloak package due to its use of MariaDB Connector/J to connect Java applications to MariaDB and MySQL databases. The vulnerability impacts availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity. It is addressed in Keycloak version 26.7.5-r3.
